rationale: The unit introduces the place route and two reference modes before its table. Mode belongs to Reference, not Object. Resolve accumulates Mode.join; Give.move requires unique resolution and Take, copy requires shared resolution and a shared stored reference, and promote requires shared resolution and Promote. The latter changes precisely the selected unique reference to shared while returning a shared reference to the same object. Take/Promote decompositions retain all other slots, class names and counters. A shared stored reference cannot produce unique path access, explaining why the table needs only three rows. The prose describes exactly these cases, including fields whose stored mode remains unique until copied.
